origin: Manually curated Noms list; no automatic ontology imports or exact source mappings.
policy: Equipment for home cooking, baking, drinks, preservation and useful regional recipes. Commonness varies by cuisine.
Categories group the review; they do not imply substitution or inheritance.
Avoid exhaustive brand, size and capacity variants. Retain common forms with functional distinctions, including cake-pan shapes and mini muffin pans.
Aliases are editorial suggestions for review, not quantitative compatibility or safety guarantees.
Related disposable supplies remain a separate scope for review. No production seed or recipe data is changed.
